proposed_from.topic: Exact proxy-cumulant depth for latent-confounded LiNGAM effects. For each integer l>=1, observe the joint law of centered (Z,T,Y) generated by the fixed single-proxy graph Z=sum_i a_i L_i+eps_Z, T=gamma Z+sum_i b_i L_i+eps_T, and Y=beta T+sum_i c_i L_i+eps_Y, with mutually independent centered non-Gaussian sources on a generic finite-moment stratum. Let r_beta(l) be the least R for which beta is constant on generic fibers of the complete observed cumulant map through order R. Characterize r_beta(l) exactly: at and above it, give a terminating algebraic beta-recovery map and exceptional discriminant; below it, construct Zariski-open real moment-feasible fibers containing legal independent finite-support unequal-beta twins. Add separated-chart k-statistic/GMM inference and simultaneous polynomial-moment confidence-fiber inversion near collisions. Credit Tramontano--Kivva--Salehkaleybar--Kiyavash--Drton ICML 2025 Theorems 3.1 and 3.4--3.6 for the sufficient k(l) order and their claimed l=1 lower bound, and distinguish the banked bivariate causal-direction frontier. The CEId-from-Moments companion implementation is the same-question consumer: the theorem changes its minimum moment order and adds an instability certificate. PRESOLVE EVIDENCE REQUIRING VERIFICATION: A stacked Z-anchored cumulant factorization A_(R,d)=B E_d was derived; full rank makes its kernel annihilate every finite source and yields beta as a rational contraction ratio. Exact centered-Bernoulli arithmetic gives r_beta(1)=3 and rejects the published quadratic extra root by a nonzero observable identity; exact calculations give 3<=r_beta(2)<=4 and r_beta(3)=4, while rank counting and legal moment charts give asymptotically matching square-root lower and upper depth bounds. Covariance twins, zero-cumulant boundaries, denominator/rank failures, real-versus-complex branches, generic-decomposition collapse, current literature, and neighboring bank entries were checked. UNRESOLVED BOTTLENECK: Classify the beta projection of every complete graph-constrained simultaneous ternary-cumulant fiber at intermediate orders, including real moment realizability, to obtain exact finite-l depths and the global lower-fiber theorem. EARLY KILL TEST: Compute the complete saturated beta elimination and exact real moment-feasible fibers for l=2 at R=3 without selecting one polynomial; stop the converse extension if the promised open legal-twin chambers do not exist. proposed_from.novelty_justification: The closest result, Tramontano et al. (2025, Theorems 3.4--3.5), identifies \(\beta\) using cumulants through \(k(\ell)\) by recovering three bivariate root lists and matching source signatures. The proposed complete-tensor annihilator instead targets \(\beta\) without reconstructing those lists and yields a strictly smaller general upper order \(U_{\ell}\). The exact \(\ell=3\) classification sharpens their specialized sufficient order \(k(3)=7\) to the necessary-and-sufficient order four and establishes generic nonidentification at order three. For \(\ell=1\), their Theorem 3.6 correctly obtains a quadratic from the vanishing ideal of the complete modified order-three map, whereas the new classification asks whether both algebraic roots lift to the explicitly defined real truncated-moment domain and certifies that the additional factor does not; this yields \(r_{\beta}(1)=3\) without disputing the published ideal computation. Schkoda, Robeva, and Drton (2024, Theorem 4) supplies the bivariate polynomial machinery but neither exploits simultaneous ternary compatibility nor characterizes target-coordinate fibers. The novel kernel is the exact finite-\(\ell\) necessary-and-sufficient depth with legal real lower fibers, not merely the already-derived improved upper bound.

seed_details.title: Exact cumulant-depth frontier for the proxy effect
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace pairwise loading-root recovery and signature matching in Theorems 3.4--3.5 by a kernel of the complete proxy-anchored ternary cumulant contraction.
seed_details.destination_search: A search for the exact target--method pair \(\{\)single proxy, graph-constrained complete ternary cumulant fiber, least order for \(\beta\)\(\}\) found the ICML sufficient bound and bivariate cumulant papers, but no exact finite-depth theorem.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from Tramontano et al. because their \(k(\ell)\)-order algorithm already identifies \(\beta\).
seed_details.rebuttal: Their construction proves sufficiency at \(k(\ell)\); it neither minimizes the complete ternary cumulant order nor supplies legal real unequal-effect fibers below it, and the complete-tensor contraction already lowers the order for \(\ell=1,2\).
seed_details.burned_reason: The sole proposal angle passed proposal hygiene after bounded repair but failed the typed D0.5 kernel-faithfulness gate.

seed_details.title: The complete \(\ell=2,R=3\) beta-fiber decision
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Retain all order-two and order-three ternary cumulants and eliminate two graph-compatible representations simultaneously, rather than selecting one polynomial from a reduced basis.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for saturated \(\ell=2\) proxy-LiNGAM elimination and real moment-feasible third-cumulant fibers returned no paper beyond the sufficient-order construction.
seed_details.red_team: A square Jacobian at \(R=3\) makes generic identification routine.
seed_details.rebuttal: A full-rank parameter-to-moment Jacobian gives local finite fibers but does not prove that their \(\beta\)-projection is a singleton or that other real legal branches are absent.

seed_details.title: Separated-chart limits and collision-robust confidence fibers
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: After replacing pairwise roots by a rational full-tensor chart, differentiate that chart away from its discriminant and invert simultaneous polynomial moment regions instead of selecting roots at collisions.
seed_details.destination_search: The target--method search found consistency for the proxy estimator, rank-constraint tests, and general singularity-robust GMM, but no confidence procedure for the beta projection of this simultaneous cumulant fiber.
seed_details.red_team: This is a direct delta-method corollary of any rational identifying formula.
seed_details.rebuttal: The regular-chart limit is routine conditional on a fixed chart, but uniform coverage through root collisions requires set-valued inversion over legal structural fibers and cannot be obtained by differentiating a selected root.

seed_details.title: Legal-real audit of the published one-latent quadratic
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Test every equation in the complete elimination ideal and every real source-moment constraint before interpreting the degree-two beta relation as two admissible preimages.
seed_details.destination_search: No public correction or independent complete-basis audit of Theorem 3.6 was located.
seed_details.red_team: A correction of one lower-bound example is too narrow for a paper.
seed_details.rebuttal: The correction changes the exact answer to \(r_{\beta}(1)=3\), but it is retained as a theorem and diagnostic inside the broader all-\(\ell\) frontier rather than as the stand-alone kernel.

seed_details.title: Source-signature-dependent effect depth
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace generic equality of source signatures in the matching argument by a rank condition on the actually nonzero cumulant-order signature matrix.
seed_details.destination_search: Full-distribution overcomplete ICA gives an if-and-only-if mixing criterion, but the search found no finite-order, source-pattern-dependent frontier for this causal coefficient.
seed_details.red_team: Vanishing odd cumulants are merely nongeneric exceptions already excluded by the anchor.
seed_details.rebuttal: Symmetric and initially moment-matched sources are scientifically common, and a pattern-dependent theorem would characterize rather than discard the entire collision strata; nevertheless it broadens the present exact-generic kernel and is deferred.

seed_details.title: Exact exceptional atlas for rational beta recovery
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Compute the radical saturated target-identification ideal and distinguish the union of chart-denominator failures from the true nonidentification locus.
seed_details.destination_search: Algebraic-identification frameworks classify generic identifiability, but no located work computes this proxy graph's beta atlas.
seed_details.red_team: An exceptional set is bookkeeping once one rational formula is known.
seed_details.rebuttal: A certificate-failure locus can strictly exceed the nonidentification locus, so equality requires a new fiber theorem; the object is valuable but narrower than the depth frontier.

seed_details.title: Effect depth versus full mixing depth
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Project the finite-cumulant mixing fiber to \(\beta\) before imposing uniqueness up to column scaling and permutation.
seed_details.destination_search: The search found full-distribution mixing identifiability and finite-order loading recovery, but no derived gap between the least order for a graph coefficient and the least order for the whole mixing matrix.
seed_details.red_team: Effect identification is automatically equivalent to mixing-matrix identification in LiNGAM.
seed_details.rebuttal: The distinguished treatment-noise column yields a contraction ratio that can be constant while nuisance source decompositions remain nonunique, so the two depths need not coincide.

seed_details.title: Data-adaptive cumulant-order selection with honest coverage
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Use rank-minor tests to choose the first certified contraction chart and account for that selection in a simultaneous confidence-fiber inversion.
seed_details.destination_search: No proxy-LiNGAM procedure was found that selects cumulant order while retaining coverage after selection.
seed_details.red_team: Bonferroni over finitely many moment orders makes the result immediate.
seed_details.rebuttal: Bonferroni controls moment-region coverage, but useful stopping and beta-set contraction near singular strata require a nontrivial nested-fiber analysis; this is better treated after the population frontier is known.

seed_details.title: Sample-size cost of the minimum identifying cumulant order
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Translate the exact algebraic order into a tail-index-dependent minimax experiment before applying empirical cumulants.
seed_details.destination_search: No minimax rate theorem was found for this proxy effect as the number of confounders and usable moment order grow.
seed_details.red_team: Without a fixed tail class the rate question is undefined, and imposing one would change the accepted model.
seed_details.rebuttal: The objection holds for the present brief; this seed is rejected rather than padded with an oracle tail assumption.

seed_details.selection_reason: The exact-depth seed has the strongest direct contradiction and constructive upper-bound evidence, contains the \(\ell=2,R=3\) decision as a decisive bounded kill test, and gives the inference seed a well-defined minimal moment vector.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The kernel is not a bare application of cumulants or do-calculus: it asks for a necessary-and-sufficient order frontier, a terminating recovery atlas, and generic legal-real converse fibers. The lower result is required on a relatively open legal moment region, not at one hand-tuned law. The inference rung is attached to the algebraic frontier and does not replace it.
